bugs.description: load_port treats an explicitly empty SERVICE_PORT as if the variable were absent, bypassing validation and silently selecting the default.
bugs.reachablePreconditions: A deployment defines SERVICE_PORT with an empty value, which can occur through an unset template substitution.
bugs.observableImpact: The process binds to port 8080 instead of rejecting malformed deployment configuration during startup.
bugs.provenance: Seeded mutation changing an absence-only check into a truthiness check; test_settings.py covers missing, empty, and valid values.
